source_inputs.derivation: lossless RGB normalization of exact variant_2.png to work around a decoder-only deflate error; no pixel edits

assets.prompt: Derive a square orthographic shadow-neutral seamless material-only albedo of the exact warm Barcelona Modernista printing-house brick from the locked front and 60-degree sources: narrow warm red and muted orange clay bricks, thin warm-grey mortar, restrained soot, age and chipped arris. Exclude architecture, ornament, windows, borders, people, sky and baked light.

Derive a square orthographic shadow-neutral seamless material-only albedo matching the exact near-black brown-warm oxidized cast iron in the locked front and 60-degree sources, with fine forge texture and restrained wear. Exclude structural shapes, rivet patterns, brick, windows, text and baked light.

Derive a square orthographic shadow-neutral seamless material-only albedo matching the exact dark charcoal-brown aged built-up flat roof inside the parapet in the locked top and 60-degree sources, with broad subtle patch seams at metre scale. Exclude skylight, parapet, railings, vents and baked shadows.

assets.role: warm stone and early concrete albedo
assets.prompt: Derive a square orthographic shadow-neutral seamless material-only albedo matching the pale warm-grey stone or early concrete plinth, sills and returns in the locked front and 60-degree sources, with fine pores and restrained mineral variation. Exclude joints, blocks, architecture and baked light.

Derive a square orthographic shadow-neutral seamless material-only albedo matching the dark warm walnut-brown timber visible in the exact front and 60-degree sources, with dense restrained grain and satin-matte age. Exclude boards, furniture shapes, facade content and baked light.

Isolate and rectify only the small circular Modernista printing-house rosette from the locked front and 60-degree sources: one restrained warm-red-brick circular ring with a blackened-iron four-spoke floral printing medallion, perfectly front-facing, complete edge visible, no gable, text, heraldry or surrounding architecture.
assets.postprocess: The built-in transparent-background edit returned a painted neutral checker in RGB. prepare_registered_identity.py flood-extracted only connected neutral checker pixels and wrote a real alpha channel; the circular identity pixels were not geometrically altered.

assets.role: aged broad-patched flat roof membrane albedo
assets.prompt: Using only the roof material visible in the three exact locked photos, derive one square shadow-neutral seamless aged dark charcoal-brown bituminous membrane with irregular broad repair patches, subtle laps, tar seams, scuffs and non-repeating weather variation; exclude modular tiles, architecture, lantern, parapets, rails and baked light.

Preserve the exact registered historic blackened wrought-iron circular printing rosette and remove all surrounding brick, mortar, backing and checker pixels; output the complete iron at native aspect on transparent RGBA without redesign.
assets.postprocess: The generator returned checker pixels in RGB. prepare_registered_identity.py flood-extracted only the connected neutral checker and wrote a verified real alpha channel; no rosette geometry was changed.
